## Use Ubuntu Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Ubuntu Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Ubuntu Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Ubuntu Mono coding font

The default monospace font for Ubuntu. Ubuntu Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Ubuntu Mono is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Ubuntu Mono FAQ

### Is Ubuntu Mono free?

Yes. Ubuntu Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Ubuntu Mono support ligatures?

No. Ubuntu Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Ubuntu Mono?

Ubuntu Mono is available from Google Fonts and Ubuntu Fonts. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
